approval_scope: Only the exact UTF-8 script bytes identified below are approved to enter narration production. This is not approval of generated audio, subtitles, final duration, rendered video, or publication.
invalidation_rule: Any change to a script byte invalidates that script approval until it is reviewed and its SHA-256 updated. Verify these hashes before narration submission or audio reuse.
script_manifest_hash_method: SHA-256 of sorted lines: chapter_id + TAB + script_sha256 + LF, encoded as UTF-8.
word_count_method: English word tokens matched with [A-Za-z]+(?:['’-][A-Za-z]+)*; the current texts have the same whitespace-token totals.
